title: What is sepsis? One sentence only.

messages.content: What is sepsis? One sentence only.

Sepsis is a life-threatening medical condition that occurs when an overwhelming immune response to an infection causes widespread inflammation and organ dysfunction (1).

Source:
(1) Surviving Sepsis Campaign. (2020). Sepsis Definition. Retrieved from <https://www.survivingsepsis.org/Sepsis-Definition/>
